# Recurrences for the new integer sequences (2026-09-28)

Each recurrence is written  c_r(n) a(n+r) + ... + c_1(n) a(n+1) + c_0(n) a(n) = 0  with integer polynomials, found by guess_rec.py
(kernel mod primes, exact lift, verified on every available term).  Zudilin's Catalan polynomials:
  P(x) = 20x^2 - 8x + 1,   Q(x) = 3520x^6 + 5632x^5 + 2064x^4 - 384x^3 - 156x^2 + 16x + 7.

## U(n) = u~_n / 30 — the zeta(7)-coefficient of Zudilin's F~_n (JTNB 2003 §7), normalised
Lucas property and Coster supercongruence verified (apery_lucas.py, apery_p2.py). Characteristic polynomial of the leading terms: lambda^4 - 9264 lambda^3 - 12116166 lambda^2 + 752300 lambda - 19683 (Zudilin's, up to lambda -> -lambda). c_0 and c_4 share an apparent-singularity factor of degree 16.

## Zudilin's Catalan numbers U_n = 16^n u_n (u_n G - v_n -> 0)
Zudilin's recurrence: c_2 = (n+2)^2(2n+3)^2 P(n+1), c_1 = -4 Q(n+1), c_0 = -256 (n+1)^2(2n+1)^2 P(n+2).
first terms: 1, 28, 2596, 311536, 41759524, 5953698928, 882922368784, 134565816860608, ...
order 2, degree 6, verified on 81 terms:
  c_0(n) = -256*(n + 1)**2*(2*n + 1)**2*(20*n**2 + 72*n + 65)
  c_1(n) = -4*(3520*n**6 + 26752*n**5 + 83024*n**4 + 134592*n**3 + 120196*n**2 + 56088*n + 10699)
  c_2(n) = (n + 2)**2*(2*n + 3)**2*(20*n**2 + 32*n + 13)

## Half-coset (recurrence) family g(j) = U(2j+1) = 2^{4j+2} y(j+1/2): the odd digits with no incoming carry
Zudilin's recurrence at half-integer index: 10j^2+26j+17 = P(j+3/2)/2, 10j^2+46j+53 = P(j+5/2)/2, middle = -2 Q(j+3/2).
first terms: 4, 256, 27904, 3571712, 495652864, 72212021248, 10868619476992, 1674408368275456, ...
order 2, degree 6, verified on 95 terms:
  c_0(j) = -256*(j + 1)**2*(2*j + 3)**2*(10*j**2 + 46*j + 53)
  c_1(j) = -32*(220*j**6 + 2332*j**5 + 10194*j**4 + 23520*j**3 + 30210*j**2 + 20485*j + 5731)
  c_2(j) = (j + 2)**2*(2*j + 5)**2*(10*j**2 + 26*j + 17)

## Carried family, odd part f(j) = F(2j+1): odd digits entered by a carry
REFLECTED Zudilin recurrence: 20j^2+48j+29 = P(-j-1), 20j^2+88j+97 = P(-j-2), and the sextic is Q(-j-2) (e.g. Q(-2) = 80503).
first terms: 4, 304, 34064, 4412608, 616387984, 90176553152, 13611453547072, 2101368763069184, ...
order 2, degree 6, verified on 48 terms:
  c_0(j) = -256*(j + 1)**2*(2*j + 3)**2*(20*j**2 + 88*j + 97)
  c_1(j) = -4*(3520*j**6 + 36608*j**5 + 156944*j**4 + 354816*j**3 + 445924*j**2 + 295296*j + 80503)
  c_2(j) = (j + 2)**2*(2*j + 5)**2*(20*j**2 + 48*j + 29)

## Carried family, even part h(n) = F(2n): even digits inside a carry run
first terms: 1, 32, 3136, 382976, 51782656, 7420936192, 1104287432704, 168714769006592, ...  (19 stable terms, M <= 36)
REFLECTED Zudilin recurrence, verified on all 19 terms and predicting integers beyond (matches the reconstructed F(38), F(40)):
  (n+2)^2 (2n+3)^2 P(-n-1/2) h(n+2) = 4 Q(-n-3/2) h(n+1) + 256 (n+1)^2 (2n+1)^2 P(-n-3/2) h(n),
  with P(-n-1/2) = 20*n**2 + 28*n + 10,  P(-n-3/2) = 20*n**2 + 68*n + 58,
  64 Q(-n-3/2) = 225280*n**6 + 1667072*n**5 + 5031936*n**4 + 7913472*n**3 + 6825984*n**2 + 3058688*n + 557056.

Reading: the carried family (digits of 2n entered by a carry of n -> 2n) satisfies Zudilin's recurrence with P and Q evaluated at
negative (reflected) arguments; the recurrence family satisfies it at positive arguments.  A carry moves a digit to the reflected side.
